summary: Sonic Automotive's amendment confirms that all CDK-provided systems including the DMS and CRM have been restored, though related CDK applications and integrations caused disruptions through July; the incident had a material impact on Q2 2024, cutting GAAP diluted EPS by about $0.64 (reported EPS $1.18) before any recoveries, and is not expected to be material to financial condition or future results.
new_vs_prior: New relative to the July 5, 2024 8-K: full restoration of access to all affected systems including CRM (previously only basic DMS functionality restored); disclosure of continued July disruptions in CDK lead, inventory and third-party integration applications; definitive conclusion that the incident was material to Q2 2024 (previously 'reasonably likely'); quantification of the hit at approximately $0.64 of GAAP diluted EPS against reported Q2 EPS of $1.18, before potential recoveries; and the conclusion that the incident is not reasonably likely to be material to financial condition or future results (previously undetermined).
